title: Counter and greeter
tagline: The browser recorder, proved on a fixture
intro: A single page with a counter and a greeter, kept in the plugin's own tests so the browser recorder has something to drive.

steps.say: Pressing the counting button raises the number on the page by one.
Typing a name and pressing the greeting button writes a hello to that name beneath it.

outro: A recorder that can count and greet here can drive a real product page the same way.
